entities.summary: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad is a mine train roller coaster located at Disneyland, Magic Kingdom in Disney World, Tokyo Disneyland and Disneyland Park (Paris). In Tokyo and Paris, the attraction is named Big Thunder Mountain. Big Thunder Mountain Railroad is also the name of the fictional rail line the roller coaster depicts.
